clue.text: Announce fantastic reduction

indicators.note: fantastic suggests something wild and fanciful, so the letters of the next word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A shop proclaims an incredible price cut.
explanation.definitionFit: To introduce a speaker or a product is to present or announce it publicly.

clue.text: Approached a raw beginner in dire straits

indicators.note: in tells us the first pieces sit inside the phrase for dire straits

parts.note: someone in dire straits is in need

indicators.note: beginner points to the opening letter of the word raw

explanation.surface: A green novice drew close while in serious trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Neared is a synonym of came close to, a past-tense verb like the clue word.

clue.text: Added comment about a marauder

indicators.note: about means the comment word is wrapped around the letter from a

parts.note: a rider is a clause or remark added to a statement or verdict

explanation.surface: Someone tacks an extra remark onto a story about a plunderer.
explanation.definitionFit: A raider is one who makes raids, a plundering attacker.

clue.text: Like Hamlet and his uncertainty

indicators.note: uncertainty implies the letters are unsettled, so the words and his are rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark on the famous prince's indecisiveness.
explanation.walkthrough: Hamlet's dithering makes 'uncertainty' look like character comment, but it signals the anagram of AND HIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's Hamlet is Prince of Denmark, so he is Scandinavian by nationality.

clue.text: Ease only after study!

indicators.note: after places the word for only behind the study word

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn
sole means only or single

explanation.surface: Relief comes only once the revision is done.
explanation.definitionFit: To console is to comfort, easing someone's grief or distress.

clue.text: A simple-minded healer

parts.note: a simple is an old name for a medicinal plant, so a healer minded towards simples treats with plants

explanation.surface: A rather dim doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Simple-minded' reads as dim-witted, but simples are medicinal herbs.
explanation.definitionFit: A herbalist practises healing with plant remedies, once called simples.

clue.text: Discontinue meetings of professional villains

parts.note: pro is short for a professional
rogues are scoundrels or villains

explanation.surface: Paid crooks call off their gatherings.
explanation.definitionFit: To prorogue a parliament is to suspend its sessions without dissolving it.

clue.text: Put back control and come to a standstill

parts.note: to rein in is to control, and a rein is a means of control
an engine that stalls stops dead

explanation.surface: A driver regains command and then the engine cuts out.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinstall software or a fitting is to set it in place once more.

clue.text: The guy getting a note carried by raven

indicators.note: carried by means the note letter is held inside the eating word

parts.note: to raven is to eat greedily, to gorge
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A man has a musical note borne by a black bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raven' looks like the bird, but here it is the verb meaning to devour.
explanation.definitionFit: George is a common man's name, so any chap can stand for a guy.

clue.text: Reviling a number making a row

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
aligning things is putting them in a line

explanation.surface: Several people quarrel while abusing someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' wants to be a quarrel; it is a line.
explanation.definitionFit: Maligning is speaking badly of someone, slandering or abusing them.

clue.text: Decoration right on a king

parts.note: the OBE is a British honour, the Order of the British Empire
taken as written

explanation.surface: A medal pinned on a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: In A Midsummer Night's Dream this figure is the fairy monarch, husband of Titania.

clue.text: Having to do with making over in hard times

parts.note: re means concerning or regarding
cession is the formal handing over of land or rights

explanation.surface: Something about makeovers during a lean economy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making over' suggests a makeover, but it means transferring, as in ceding territory.
explanation.definitionFit: An economic downturn of falling output and jobs brings hard times.

clue.text: Promise to settle on the quiet

indicators.note: in an across clue on puts the settling word after the quiet letter

parts.note: p is the musical marking piano, soft or quiet
to light on something is to settle or land on it

explanation.surface: A secret agreement made quietly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the quiet' reads as secretly, but it splits: P (quiet) comes first, with LIGHT placed on it.
explanation.definitionFit: To plight one's troth is to pledge one's word, especially in marriage.

clue.text: Rate increase causing delay

parts.note: tempo is speed or rate, especially in music
a rise is an increase

explanation.surface: A hike in interest rates slows things down.
explanation.definitionFit: To temporise is to stall or play for time, avoiding a decision.

clue.text: Soldiers forcibly recruited may well be subdued

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
press gangs pressed men into naval service

explanation.surface: Conscripted troops would likely be downcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Repressed feelings are held down or restrained, as is something subdued.

clue.text: Go in and serve newly-appointed chief

indicators.note: newly appointed suggests a fresh arrangement, so the letters are put in new order

explanation.surface: A recently installed leader is urged to enter and do service.
explanation.definitionFit: A sovereign is a supreme ruler or head of state.

clue.text: Some people are very serious-earnest-deep

indicators.note: some here means a part of the following words is taken

explanation.surface: Certain people are profoundly solemn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deep' looks like another word for serious, but it is the definition: the deep is the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: The deep is a poetic name for the ocean.

clue.text: Ready for a party?

explanation.surface: Prepared for a celebration?
explanation.definitionFit: On your marks, get set means prepared; a set is also a group or clique of people.

clue.text: In a beautiful dream youth meets girl

indicators.note: in means the answer is found inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A lad in a lovely dream encounters a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Amy is a female first name.

clue.text: Regards money abroad as a bad thing

parts.note: to eye something is to look at or regard it
the ore is a coin of Sweden, Denmark and Norway

explanation.surface: Someone views foreign cash as evil.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyesore is an ugly sight, something unpleasant to look at.

clue.text: Married ladies possibly get a questionable share-out

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters may be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Wives might end up with an unfair division of goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A misdeal is a wrong distribution of cards, a faulty share-out.

clue.text: Aim to cause annoyance

explanation.surface: Setting out deliberately to irritate.
explanation.definitionFit: To try is to attempt or aim; to try someone's patience is to vex them.

clue.text: Storm about a representative being upstanding

indicators.note: about means the storm word wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: to rant is to storm or rage
an MP is a Member of Parliament, an elected representative

explanation.surface: Someone rages at an honest politician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upstanding' looks like honest; in heraldry a lion rampant stands on its hind legs.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry a rampant beast is shown rearing up on its hind legs.

clue.text: Stout doorman

explanation.surface: A plump commissionaire.
explanation.definitionFit: Porter is a dark beer like stout, and also a gatekeeper at a building's entrance.

clue.text: Avoid responsibility for firm-up to collapse

parts.note: Co is short for company, a firm

indicators.note: collapse suggests a breakdown, so the letters of up to are jumbled

explanation.surface: A company left to crumble dodges its obligations.
explanation.definitionFit: To cop out is to back away from a commitment or duty.

clue.text: Running water supplied by master-builder

indicators.note: builder implies constructing anew, so the letters of master are rebuilt

explanation.surface: A construction boss provides the flowing water.
explanation.definitionFit: A stream is a small river, a flow of water.

clue.text: An administrative fellow is from a South American range

parts.note: a dean is a college official who runs administration

explanation.surface: A university official comes from the Andes.
explanation.definitionFit: Andean describes things belonging to the Andes mountains of South America.

clue.text: Outstanding though mean worker

parts.note: an import is a meaning, what something means
a worker ant is the standard crossword worker

explanation.surface: A distinguished but stingy employee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mean' reads as stingy; it is the noun meaning sense or significance.
explanation.definitionFit: Something outstanding is significant, prominent and of great weight.

clue.text: Took things easy the Oriental way when in debt

indicators.note: in means the pieces go inside the debt word

parts.note: being in the red means being in debt
E is short for east, the Orient
St is short for street, a way

explanation.surface: Someone lounged about Eastern-style while owing money.
explanation.definitionFit: Rested means relaxed or took a break, a past-tense verb phrase like the clue.

clue.text: It just shows the pressure everybody's under!

definitions.text: It just shows the pressure everybody's under!

parts.words: It just shows the pressure everybody's under!
parts.note: a weather instrument literally displays the air pressure all of us live beneath

explanation.surface: A remark on how stressed everyone is.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase reads as a sigh about stress; literally it means atmospheric pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: An instrument measuring atmospheric pressure, used in weather forecasting.

clue.text: Transport and plant without cash

indicators.note: without means outside, so the plant word goes around the cash letter

parts.note: sedge is a grass-like marsh plant
L stands for pound, from Latin libra, as in money

explanation.surface: Moving goods and a factory with no money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking, but here it means outside, putting SEDGE around L.
explanation.definitionFit: A sledge is a vehicle on runners for carrying goods over snow.

clue.text: Account for testament's crumpled appearance

indicators.note: a crumpled look means the letters are creased into a new arrangement

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A will that looks rather the worse for wear.
explanation.definitionFit: A statement is a written account, such as one from a bank or witness.
